defects: Most of the 13 cuts swap the colour grade (dark, bone, amber, bone, dark) on what looks like a continuous simulation. They read as palette flashes, not new shots, so the cut count overstates how much really changes.
In the end frame a glossy sphere sits over the lower-centre blob. Its contour lines run the wrong way, and it reads as a render or compositing artifact, not part of the simulation.
Contour isolines inside the blobs look stepped at 100%. They read as banding in the height map, not smooth shading.
The dish is cropped at the frame edges in several shots (frames 1–4). Blobs collide with the rim and get cut off, which weakens the composition.
The pairs barely move at 1/6 s. Growth is slow and uniform, with no easing, anticipation or settle, and the zoom shot reads as a linear push.
The audio uses gated white-noise blocks with hard on/off edges at about 3.9 s and about 7.9 s, plus a linear filter riser. It reads as procedural synth, not mixed sound design.
The end card type is small, low-contrast mono. 'grown live, on the beat' tells us the concept instead of the picture proving it.
gaps: Motion: the only on-screen move is the simulation growing at a constant rate, and transitions are hard palette swaps. Top studio work would let audio hits drive visible events in the medium (splits, pulses, fronts racing outward). It would also add camera moves with weight and eased settles, and a real build in growth speed toward the 6–8 s peak.

Sound: the track is a noise riser, a broadband noise wall, sparse clicks and sine plucks. It has few partials, a static spectrum and no low-end design. It needs produced music or wet, organic Foley-style sound for the material (squelch, membrane, bubble), with mix dynamics instead of gated noise blocks.

Finish: the stepped isolines, the stray sphere artifact and the edge-cropped dish keep it from looking like premium specimen photography. It needs smoother height shading, real optical depth of field and a refraction/caustic pass on the glass, and clean framing in every shot.
